panel.heading: Triage
panel.lead: The analyst's decision on this anomaly. It is separate from the detector's state, which triage never changes.
panel.untouched: Nobody has acted on this anomaly yet.
panel.takeItHelp: Make me the owner and set the status to In progress
panel.assignLabel: Owner (any name or sign-in; up to {max} characters)
panel.assignHint: Leave empty to remove the owner.
panel.readOnly: You can read this triage but not change it. Changing it needs the anomaly:triage permission.
panel.accessUnknown: Your permissions could not be checked, so changes are switched off. Reload the page to try again.
panel.loadFailed: The triage of this anomaly could not be loaded. Nothing is shown rather than a guess; the rest of the page is unaffected.
panel.unavailable: Triage is not available for this kind of anomaly. It covers log-source, WAF, IPS and property-watch anomalies.
panel.conflictBody: {actor} last changed it, <time></time>. It is now {status}, {owner}. Your change was not saved.
panel.conflictUnread: Someone else changed this triage, and their version could not be read. Your change was not saved. Reload the page to see the current state.
panel.activityEmpty: No activity yet. Taking, assigning or closing this anomaly, and comments, appear here.
panel.activityFailed: The activity could not be loaded. Try again.
